subject.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes

question: Should ClawHub accept `mode=prefix|exact` on `/api/v1/search` plus `clawhub search --prefix/--exact` as the stable solution for registry-style skill discovery?
rationale: The code is narrow and indexed, but it adds public API and CLI surface for an issue already marked as needing maintainer product/API direction, and it does not provide cursor-pageable full enumeration.

options.title: Accept bounded search modes
options.body: Treat the new search modes as the intended public contract, then require docs and real CLI/API proof before merge.

options.title: Require pageable discovery
options.body: Ask for a cursor-pageable `/api/v1/skills` or dedicated list-style path before closing the linked issue.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR until maintainers choose the registry discovery surface.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded search modes
recommendation.body: Treat the new search modes as the intended public contract, then require docs and real CLI/API proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the live requested reviewer and has the strongest recent history on the affected API, CLI, and owner-scoped skill surfaces.
